AITPM (AI and Theorem Provers in Mathematics) Workshop

Online Workshop 8-10 April 2026

Registration (free) and full programme is available at the AITPM workshop website.

Invited Speakers

  • Kevin Buzzard @Kevin Buzzard (Imperial College)
  • Minhyong Kim (International Centre for Mathematical Sciences, Edinburgh)
  • Yang-Hui He @Yang-Hui He (London Institute for Mathematical Sciences)
  • Paola Iannone (University of Edinburgh)
  • Shinichi Mochizuki (Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences Kyoto)
  • Leonardo De Moura @Leonardo de Moura (Amazon Web Services)
  • Lawrence Paulson @Lawrence Paulson (University Cambridge)
  • Chelsea Edmonds @Chelsea Edmonds (University of Western Australia)
  • Patrick Massot @Patrick Massot (University Paris Saclay)

Organisers

  • Mohamed Saidi (Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of Exeter)
  • Barrie Cooper @Barrie Cooper  (Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of Exeter)
  • Gihan Marasingha @Gihan Marasingha  (Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of Exeter)
  • Achim D. Brucker @Achim Brucker  (Department of Computer Science, University of Exeter)
  • Diego Marmsoler @Diego Marmsoler (Department of Computer Science, University of Exeter)
Will the talks be recorded and made available later?

Ching-Tsun Chou said:

Will the talks be recorded and made available later?

Yes, for those speakers who have given their permission.
This topic was moved here from #General announcements > AI and Theorem Provers in Mathematics (April 2026) by Eric Wieser.
I filled in the online form a while ago and have heard nothing back - does that mean my application has been rejected, or have the organisers just not gotten around to it?

Do not worry, there is no 'rejection". We are just in the process of sorting out the final details for the online setup. Detailed instructions will be emailed to all who have registered on Tuesday (UK evening).

Ching-Tsun Chou said:

Will the talks be recorded and made available later?

They're now up on YouTube.
